title: Independent verification of the V0.3-12-C surface
objective: Independently verify the delivered V0.3-12-C surface by reading apps/desktop/src/orchestration/project-open.ts and its test file, and report, with evidence, which acceptance claims you can confirm from the code and which you cannot. Nothing may be modified: this is a read-only verification whose only written artefact is the evidence JSON named in allowed_paths. The point of this task is to be a real, strictly limited engineering task that a worker executes while independent active-worker telemetry is recorded by the Main Agent.
scope: Read-only verification of one V0.3-12 delivery surface, plus one evidence file.
non_goals: Re-running or replacing the V0.3-12 acceptance evidence
Any change to tools/agent, .agent/schemas or the CI configuration
acceptance_criteria: The evidence file names the exact file paths read and the exact commands run
Each claimed finding cites the file and the line or symbol it came from
At least one claim is marked as not confirmable, or the absence of one is stated
handoff_requirements: Report the exact commands run and their exit codes
Report the evidence JSON as changed_files
